summaryEvents.text: Calibration is complete. The connector is clear of the PC and below the inlet; the agent approaches while checking for tip contact.
The tip meets the inlet rim with fingers clear. A pin is still visible, so the agent eases preload and shifts toward the opening.
Fresh wrist views confirm entry with no exposed pin or visible gap. The agent begins insertion.
The connector has advanced and remains engaged in all three views. The agent reverses a tilt that increased bending.
Engagement remains visible after alignment. The agent prepares to unload, open the gripper and reposition for a cable-shoulder push.
The gripper is open and the connector remains in the inlet. The cable is centered between the fingers for regrasping and a straight push.
A further push produces limited advance and increased axial load. The agent eases preload while keeping the gripper closed.
The agent prepares to unload pressure, open the gripper and verify release before withdrawing.
